full.description: This is a high-power light micrograph of a lymph node tissue section stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The image reveals sheets of large, discohesive pleomorphic cells with prominent nuclei and chunky chromatin. These characteristic cytomorphologic features are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The cellular infiltrate shows abundant large malignant lymphoid cells replacing the normal nodal architecture.

random.description: This is a high-power histopathological micrograph of lymph node tissue stained with H&E. The image reveals a dense infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells showing pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and frequent mitotic figures. The cytomorphological features are characteristic of a high-grade malignant lymphoma, such as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
